content:
After the Liquid Glass redesign officially rolled out to most iOS WhatsApp users, the messaging platform is now testing another visual change, this time focusing on the appearance of chat bubbles. Here are the details.

New chat bubbles look more rounded

A few months ago, WhatsApp finally began rolling out the Liquid Glass redesign more widely, after months of testing and refining the new design through TestFlight with select users.

Around the same time, WABetaInfo found signs in the app's code that WhatsApp chat bubbles would be redesigned. Now, the website reports that the new bubbles have started rolling out to some users running the latest TestFlight version.

WABetaInfo reports as follows:

In addition to reshaping message bubbles, the new design also changes how media and links are displayed in conversations. WhatsApp has removed the green border surrounding them, making photos, videos, GIFs, and link previews look cleaner and more seamless.

WABetaInfo points out that the new design is currently only available to some users running the WhatsApp TestFlight version. It is unknown when it will be rolled out more widely to all iOS users.
